title: 第294章再去市里送货
slug: 临时加彩礼转头另娶绝美女知青
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

医生没有给陈卫东开检查单，而是冲他道：“你别急，我慢慢给你检查。

你将裤子脱了，我看看你的生殖器官有没有问题。”

很多出现生育问题的人，其实生殖器官有点儿问题。

陈卫东虽然觉得当着别的男人的面脱裤子让对方检查有点难为情，但想到对方是医生，自己想要检查问题，那就必须配合。

这么想着，陈卫东纠结了一下，最后还是按照医生的要求，将裤子脱了下来。

医生也帮着陈卫东检查起来。

检查的时候，这位男医生觉得自己受到了不小的打击。

人和人之间的差距真大，在陈卫东面前，这位男医生觉得自己的自信心都被打击没了。

陈卫东被检查的时候，脸颊热热的。

虽然他脸皮挺厚实的，但是在这样的情况下，也会觉得不好意思。

当着女人的面脱裤子就算了，可这面对的不是一个男人嘛？

男医生检查完，才冲陈卫东道：“看着问题不大，同志，你先不用着急，你结婚的时间不长，再等等看。

而且这种事，不是一方的问题，而是双方的问题。

一年后你们再不能怀上孩子，可以一起来医院检查。

如果实在着急要孩子的话，过半年没要上的话，就来医院检查。”

听了医生的话，陈卫东只好点点头说：“那行，医生，我再等等看。”

男医生忍不住的又说了一句：“小同志，你不用焦虑，你这看上去不像是不行的，要是你不行的话，不知道多少人不行了。”

“好，医生，我知道了，我尽量放平心态。”

从医院这边离开，陈卫东便骑车回红旗生产队了。

快到大队时，陈卫东才从空间里取出一辆板车，又将五台从二手平台上购买的缝纫机拿出来放上去。

到大队时，陈卫东便直接将五台缝纫机送去了制衣厂那边。

新增了五台设备，制衣厂这边有些放不下了。

Page (1/3)

The doctor did not write a check-up sheet for Chen Weidong, but said to him: "Don't be anxious, I will check you slowly.

Take off your pants and let me see if there are any problems with your reproductive organs."

Many people who have fertility problems actually have problems with their reproductive organs.

Although Chen Weidong felt a little embarrassed to take off his pants in front of other men for him to check, he thought that the other man was a doctor and he wanted to check the problem, so he had to cooperate.

Thinking like this, Chen Weidong struggled for a while, and finally took off his pants as the doctor asked.

The doctor also helped Chen Weidong check up.

During the examination, the male doctor felt that he had been hit hard.

The gap between people is so big. In front of Chen Weidong, the male doctor felt that his self-confidence had been shattered.

When Chen Weidong was examined, his cheeks felt hot.

Although he is quite thick-skinned, he would feel embarrassed in such a situation.

It's okay to take off your pants in front of a woman, but isn't she facing a man?

After the male doctor finished the examination, he said to Chen Weidong: "It doesn't seem to be a big problem, comrade, don't worry, you haven't been married for long, wait and see."

And this kind of thing is not a problem of one party, but a problem of both parties.

After one year, if you can no longer conceive a child, you can come to the hospital for examination together.

If you are really anxious to have a baby and you haven't had a baby in six months, come to the hospital for a checkup."

After listening to the doctor's words, Chen Weidong had no choice but to nod and said: "That's okay, doctor, I'll wait and see."

The male doctor couldn't help but said again: "Comrade, you don't need to be anxious. It doesn't look like you can't do it. If you can't do it, I don't know how many people will."

"Okay, doctor, I understand. I'll try to calm down."

After leaving the hospital, Chen Weidong rode back to the Hongqi production team.

When he was almost at the brigade, Chen Weidong took out a cart from the space and put five sewing machines purchased from a second-hand platform on it.

When he arrived at the brigade, Chen Weidong sent five sewing machines directly to the garment factory.

Five new pieces of equipment have been added, and the garment factory can no longer accommodate them.
